verdict.rationale: Fathom's docs describe an official MCP server that connects meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, with a remote server URL (https://api.fathom.ai/mcp) and an authentication step. They also give concrete setup paths: an official Claude connector and a Claude Code `claude mcp add` command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented, and documentation of the specific tools/capabilities the MCP server exposes to agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude
